summary: Expanded the universe around B2B coffee, tea, extracts, and private-label beverage solutions with a bias toward less obvious public-market mappings. The cleanest direct public exposure found is Westrock Coffee, which explicitly positions itself as an integrated coffee, tea, flavors, extracts, and ingredient solutions provider serving foodservice, restaurants, retail, CPG, convenience, hospitality, and related channels. Adjacent second-order mappings include foodservice distributors with office-coffee or beverage channels, branded/away-from-home coffee manufacturers exposed to green-coffee cost volatility, and small coffee brands that may reveal supplier/co-manufacturing dependencies. Farmer Bros. would have been a strong micro-cap pure-play historically, but current search evidence indicates it was acquired and delisted in May 2026, so it is excluded from the active US-listed candidate list.
